item.text: {"claim_id":"C053","obligation_id":"C053-B-1","contract":"GOVERNANCE_STRUCTURE","subject":"The trial should be suspended for credible increased harm or service disruption.","verdict":"VIOLATED","unresolved_conditions":[],"rationale":"P038 expresses a prospective, internally coherent suspension rule with a clear response.
